annual_rate.notes: New Mexico prejudgment interest splits by claim type: for unliquidated claims (e.g. personal injury) a court may award UP TO 10% in its discretion (NMSA 1978 §56-8-4(B)); for liquidated/contract 'money due by contract' claims, 15% applies as of right (§56-8-3). Verified 2026-07-11. Not legal advice.
